name: pdlc-workflows
//c8-per-file: `test:coverage` is two stages. Stage 1 (`c8 npm test`) applies the `c8` block below in AGGREGATE. Stage 2 re-reports the same run with `--per-file`, enforcing only the floor DoD criterion 4 names — branch >= 85% — on EVERY included module (the other three are passed 0 because their aggregate floors are already enforced by stage 1; naming per-file numbers for them would mean lowering the declared 90 to orchestrate-queue.js's 77.46% functions, i.e. weakening the declaration to fit the code). Without stage 2 the block's floors are not the floors it enforces: orchestrate-dev.js is ~15k lines and dominates the aggregate, so a small module could sit under 85% branch unnoticed (CODE_REVIEW v2 §1-1).
//c8: Coverage is measured by c8, not by jest's own --coverage: under --experimental-vm-modules the modules under test are evaluated as ESM through jest's vm-module path, where babel instrumentation reports 0% for them. c8 reads V8's own coverage and sees them. The include set is the modules this feature edits (CODE_REVIEW v1 §1-2); dist/ is generated and __tests__/ is the measuring instrument, so neither is a subject.
